verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has a TypeDoc-generated API reference with class pages such as BABYLON.NullEngine. It also offers an interactive Playground code editor with sharing at playground.babylonjs.com, so the runnable-example and reference pieces both exist. Community comments repeatedly praise the documentation. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference pages link to or embed runnable Playground examples, and the docs are client-rendered with no markdown mirrors, which limits AI-native exploration. Missing for 10: evidence of runnable examples embedded or linked per API entry, machine-readable (.md) reference pages, independent hands-on corroboration of the reference-to-Playground workflow.
